current_role: U.S. senator from Hawaii; chief deputy whip and front-runner for Democratic whip
summary: Brian Schatz has been a U.S. senator from Hawaii since December 2012, after serving as the state's lieutenant governor. A progressive Democrat and the caucus's chief deputy whip, he moved quickly after Dick Durbin announced his retirement and has lined up support, including Chuck Schumer's, to become the No. 2 Senate Democrat in 2027.
